source.name: Louisville Metro KY - Gun Violence Data
source.where: DateTime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND DateTime < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND Crime_Type IN ('Homicide','Non-Fatal Shooting')

contract.worker_judgment_notes: Selected the official Louisville/LOJIC Gun Violence Data ArcGIS point feature layer because it provides incident/victim rows with DateTime, Crime_Type/Cause, Case_Number/ObjectId, and point geometry/Latitude/Longitude. The broader Louisville Metro KY - Crime Data 2024 open-data layer was checked but not selected because the ArcGIS service is a table and returned no geometry, despite having stronger NIBRS offense detail. This is a share-lane-only contract: the source covers homicides and non-fatal shootings, not all seven Part I categories, and raw feed counts should not be promoted as Louisville annual totals. The source notes LMPD division coverage, exclusion of smaller class cities unless LMPD is involved, preliminary data subject to later investigation, and obfuscated victim-location points. Case_Number duplicates occur for multi-victim/multi-row events, so the contract uses a composite identity with Case_Number, Crime_Type, DateText, Latitude, Longitude, and ObjectId. The DateText select expression is derived from DateTime so the generic runner parses ArcGIS dates as 2024 timestamps rather than epoch milliseconds. Murder maps only official Crime_Type Homicide rows, which the source describes as criminal incidents excluding non-criminal cases; aggravated_assault maps only Crime_Type Non-Fatal Shooting with Cause Gun Shot Wound. ShotSpotter alerts are excluded in the ArcGIS where clause. Bounds are a buffered envelope around the repo municipal block-group footprint for jurisdiction 21:municipal:place:2148000 computed from state/geometry/block_group_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet and data/tiger_bg/tl_2020_21_bg.zip; the runner should still spatially join points to municipal block groups.
